$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services-emergency pack composed with an electrician content seed and an amber brand over the sitework register. Everything else — pages, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Electrician
description: An electrician site built for the emergency call: a phone number that never leaves the viewport, flat printed prices, response-time proof, a four-step dispatch story, and a callback form for everything that can wait — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

theme.$comment: Amber over the sitework register's plan-grid ground — the dispatch shape's utility-blue plumber recolored to the electrical trade's high-visibility voice. mode dark opens the site on the register's night shift (floodlit-yard ground, bone type, the amber at vest brightness — the trade that works when the lights are out; the appearance toggle still swaps to the daylight sheet). Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesEmergencyShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the base plumber wears the split dispatch bar, so the electrician takes the full-width translucent band — flush chrome over the night-shift ground — per the nav-variety audit.
